## What he does

Prudent Bird is a full-stack and AI engineer. He designs and ships end-to-end
products involving infra, frontend, backend, and the AI layers in between with a focus on
tools people actually use. Core areas of expertise:

- AI Engineering
- Cloud & DevOps
- Web Development
- Software Engineering
- Full Stack Development
- React, Next.js, TypeScript, Effect, Python
